coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals, including single-family homes, mobile homes and parks, apartment buildings, and rooming and boarding houses. Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings are subject only to a narrower list of causes.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings: eviction only for holdover after lease expiry, nonpayment, disorderly conduct, willful damage, constant rule violations, or lease violations where re-entry is reserved.
coverage.other_conditions: Hotel and motel occupants with no alternate residence who live there continuously are covered.

result.notes: I removed the sentence in other_conditions saying unregistered landlords cannot evict. It describes landlord conduct, and it comes from the separate Landlord Identity Law (N.J.S.A. 46:8-27 to -37), not from the coverage of this Act. The other coverage values are kept, each supported by a verbatim passage from D067. The owner-occupied cap of 3 reflects the guide's two- and three-family owner-occupied carve-out. Those dwellings are only partly exempt: they remain subject to a narrower list of causes. requires_unknown_facts is left null for lack of a direct passage.
